questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . The postman / delivers the letters / through hand, / door to door.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The postman / delivers the letters / through hand, / door to door.
questions.solution: 'by hand' will be used instead of 'through hand' because 'through hand' is an incorrect way to indicate the distribution of letters. The correct phrase is 'by hand'.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The committee will ________________ a survey on the government schemes.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The committee will ________________ a survey on the government schemes.
questions.solution: Conduct' should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing the action of carrying out a survey on government schemes by the committee. Here, through "The committee will ________________ a survey on the government schemes", it is portrayed that the committee will be involved in the process of surveying government schemes. In this context, "conduct" would be the most appropriate choice as it is commonly used to describe a formal and organized process.

questions.questionHtml:

Though his staff is often confused by the way he runs the office, I've found that there's (a) method in/to his madness

options.text: Someone who is unpredictable and can cause damage if not kept in check.
options.html: Someone who is unpredictable and can cause damage if not kept in check.
To get someone drunk.

options.text: To state a fact so that there are no doubts or objections.
options.html: To state a fact so that there are no doubts or objections.

options.text: Strange or crazy actions that appear meaningless but in the end are done for a good reason.

questions.solution: D) Method to my madness (phrase) – Strange or crazy actions that appear meaningless but in the end are done for a good reason व्यवहार वास्तव में इतना मूर्खतापूर्ण नहीं जितना दिखाई देता है.

questions.question: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. There was very poor receptivity due from technological glitches; nonetheless, the online class was continued.

Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

There was very poor receptivity due from technological glitches; nonetheless, the online class was continued.

options.html: There was very poor receptivity
the online class was continued
due from technological glitches

questions.solution: 'due to' will be used instead of 'due from' because 'due to' is used to express the reason or cause of something, like— There was very poor receptivity due to technological glitches; nonetheless, the online class was continued

questions.question: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correctspelling from the given options I received good concesions while purchasing a mobile phone
questions.questionHtml:

I received good concesions while purchasing a mobile phone

questions.solution: the roads were' will be used instead of 'the roads was' because 'roads' is a Plural Noun and with Plural Subject, the Verb 'were' is used; Like— After the rain, the roads were wet and waterlogged in some places

questions.questionHtml:

Which________does the minister take to reach the Assembly?
questions.solution: 'Route' should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing the path that the politician takes to reach the Assembly.
